title: 一颗豆子怎么发芽
subtitle: 它自己带着饭盒
character: wearing a light green t-shirt, beige trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in botanical watercolour style, soft transparent washes with fine brown ink outlines, fresh leaf green and warm earth palette, plenty of clean white paper

pages.zh:
妈妈给了我一颗干干的豆子，
硬硬的，圆圆的。
她说，把它种到土里，
过几天就会长出小苗。
我有点不相信。
pages.scene: The little boy holds one dry bean in his open palm, looking at it closely, a small pot of soil on the table beside him.

pages.zh:
先把豆子剖开看看。
里面有两片厚厚的东西，
那是「子叶」，
是豆子给自己
准备的第一顿饭。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bean split open on a cream background showing two thick halves inside and one tiny curled plant between them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
两片子叶中间，
藏着一个很小的芽。
上面一头会长成茎和叶，
下面一头会长成根。
它早就准备好了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bean seen in cross-section on a cream background with the tiny embryo drawn large: a small shoot pointing up and a small root pointing down. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
干豆子在睡觉。
它要醒过来，
需要三样东西：
水、空气，
还有不冷不热的温度。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three small symbols in a row on a cream background: a water drop, a small swirl of air and a thermometer at a middle level. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
先喝水。
豆子泡在水里，
慢慢胀大，皮被撑得发皱。
里面睡着的芽，
被水叫醒了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two beans side by side on a cream background: the left one small and smooth, the right one swollen with a wrinkled skin. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最先钻出来的是根。
它一头扎进土里，
抓住土，
再从土里吸水。
根总是往下长。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bean just under the soil surface on a cream background with one white root coming out of it and growing downward. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
然后芽往上顶。
它弯着腰，
像一个小钩子，
用背先顶开土，
免得嫩芽被土磨坏。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one seedling in soil cross-section on a cream background bent into a hook shape, pushing up through the soil with the bend first. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
钻出地面以后，
它才慢慢直起腰，
把两片子叶举起来。
这时候它吃的，
还是自己带的那顿饭。
pages.scene: One young bean seedling standing on soil on a cream background with two thick seed leaves opened at the top. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
接着长出真正的叶子。
叶子是绿的，
里面有叶绿素，
能用阳光、水和空气
自己做出糖来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one seedling on a cream background with two thin true leaves above the seed leaves, three straight sun rays arriving at the leaves. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
真叶一开始工作，
两片子叶就慢慢变黄、变小，
最后掉下来。
饭盒空了，
小苗已经能自己养活自己。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one seedling on a cream background with green true leaves at the top and two shrivelled yellow seed leaves below, one of them falling off. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
根越扎越深，
茎越长越高。
要是光只从一边来，
茎就会朝着光弯过去。
它一直在找太阳。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one plant in a pot on a cream background leaning toward a window at the left, with straight light rays coming from that side. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
第七天早上，
花盆里冒出了一个小小的绿芽。
它弯着腰，
慢慢地直起身子。
我每天都去看它一次。
pages.scene: The little boy leans over a small pot on a windowsill where one green seedling has come up, his face close to it, delighted.
